headline: Wardens Sweep Weathered Expanse as Callahan's Passage Rekindles
war_summary: The Weathered Expanse has swung hard: where our last edition counted four Warden posts against two Colonial, the Wardens now hold seven of nine, two lying in ruins, and the pace there is unmatched — fifty-six recorded actions in a day, losses topping a thousand an hour on each side, Crow's Nest and Wightwalk the busiest grounds, the latest stroke logged at press time. Callahan's Passage, silent two hours past, has rekindled with two fresh actions and two-hour losses nearing sixteen hundred on the Warden roll; its line now reads eight Warden posts, one Colonial, one in ruins. Palantine Berm still seethes about The Droll, six Warden posts to one Colonial. On Stlican Shelf the Colonials have re-established their abandoned ground, eight posts to one, though the churn at Briar goes on. The Nevish Line has been quiet since evening, holding seven Warden posts to one. Linn of Mercy records no post changes yet carries heavy Warden losses, while Callums Cape saw four rapid exchanges at Scouts Jest after long stillness. Elsewhere the 515th-day front lies largely untroubled; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
